message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout. I rummaged through my drawers like a scene from a treasure hunt, only to discover my trusty flashlight was dead as a doornail. 🤦‍♂️ I stumbled around, bumping into furniture and giggling at my own clumsiness. Eventually, I found my phone, which of course was nearly out of battery too! 

After a few minutes of fumbles, I remembered my power bank tucked away in my bag. I felt like a hero charging up my phone. So, lesson learned: it’s always good to keep your essentials ready to go, even if it means a little comedy along the way! 

What’s your go-to trick for staying comfy during a blackout?
